limitations: No nonlinear closed-loop reachability guarantee is implied.
Strategy preparation proves required dependency admission, not that execution invoked each dependency.
Continuous parameter spaces are represented only by named finite profiles.
External acados execution and installation remain prohibited.
Build availability and native admission receipts must be emitted by the exact compiled build; this source inventory alone is not a receipt.
identity_policy: Registered provider IDs and versions are source literals. Public functions are identified by exported C++ symbols without invented version IDs.

first_unmet.reason: The delivered fixed-frame parallelotope trace requires its four-state TwoPoints profile.
QuickHull2D accepts two-dimensional points only; no projection is inserted implicitly.
No source-supported MPC11 orbit model/episode adapter exists.
The finite-plan traces do not provide the common feedback predecessor and first-action recovery route.
The existing MPC11 contract prohibits acados execution and installation.

first_unmet_when_unavailable.reason: Qhull converter target is not compiled in this build.
